test_is_network_accessible: test the is_network_accessible() helper to classify IPv4, IPv6, and hostname addresses as loopback or network-accessible
test_connect_bind_guard: test the APIServerAdapter.connect() startup guard that refuses non-loopback binding without an API key
test_hostname_resolution: test is_network_accessible() with mocked DNS resolution for localhost, non-loopback, and mixed-address hostnames
test_dns_failure_fails_closed: test that is_network_accessible() returns True for unresolvable hostnames to fail closed and require an API key
test_wildcard_with_api_key: test that APIServerAdapter.connect() allows wildcard bind addresses when an API key is provided
